# UI Style Kit Icons

Source version: 2.0.0
Contract version: 1
Collection: 01
Repository: https://github.com/Foscat/ui-style-kit-icons
Demo: https://foscat.github.io/ui-style-kit-icons/

UI Style Kit Icons publishes 174 semantic icons across 20 families. Each family
has a theme-aware SVG under svg/<family>/ and a one-ink SVG under
monochrome/<family>/. The 6,960 authoritative asset hashes are recorded in
reference/asset-hashes.json.

Primary imports:

- ui-style-kit-icons/element
- ui-style-kit-icons/registry
- ui-style-kit-icons/contract.json
- ui-style-kit-icons/css.css
- ui-style-kit-icons/inline-svg
- ui-style-kit-icons/svg/<family>/<icon-id>.svg
- ui-style-kit-icons/monochrome/<family>/<icon-id>.svg

The custom element defaults to Organic Modern. Use pack or data-icon-pack to
choose a family and variant="monochrome" for one-ink artwork. Unknown retired
families fail instead of resolving to unrelated artwork.

The paint layer aligns with ui-style-kit-css >=2.7.1 <3 and supports 25 palettes
in light, dark, and contrast modes. Motion Style CSS 1.0.0 is vendored only for
the demo's lifecycle choreography.

Development commands:

- npm run demo
- npm run build
- npm run assets:check
- npm run verify
- npm run pages:build

Local verification, registry publication, GitHub Actions, Pages deployment,
and live-site acceptance are separate evidence classes.
